Each tent in Porini Camps has 1 double bed & 1 single bed so 3 adults can be accommodated. 3rd adult pays the same per person sharing rates.
We have 02 family unit at each of Porini Amboseli, Porini Lion and Porini Rhino Camp, 01 Family Unit at Porini Mara . This comprises 2 ensuite tents with an interconnecting lounge. The family unit is sold as 2

Minimum nights: 2 nights at Porini camps. This doesn’t apply for Rhino River Camp and Nairobi Tented Camp.
Exclusive use of any Porini Camps requires a minimum booking of two nights.

pages.text:
TERMS & CONDITIONS
1 child pays 60% of per person sharing rates when sharing with 2 adults in 1 tent & the 2 adults pay per person sharing rates each.
Child Policy: 8 - 1 child pays 60% of per person sharing rates when sharing with 1 adult BUT the 1 adult pays full single tent rate.
16 years 2 children in own tent pay 75% of per person sharing rates each, 3rd child in same tent pays 75% of per person sharing rate.
The camp is not suitable for children under 8 years of age
For any booking traveling from December 20th till Jan 2nd 2027 and for a minimum of 8 nights combining our Porini Camps – we will extend a 15% discount on the total booking cost.
Honeymoon offer: 50% off for Bride when staying 4 or more nights at any Porini Safari Camp and valid all year except in August & September when the bride gets 25% off when staying for 4 or more
nights at any Porini Safari Camp.*Proof of wedding required and offer is valid for travel within 12 months of wedding. (Honeymoon offer is not combinable with any other)
Special Offers:
Solo travelers to any Porini Camp get to stay at no extra cost for being in a single tent; This offer is valid for travel from November 1st until December 19th, and from January 2nd - 31st May 26.
Pay Stay Offer : Enjoy an exclusive offer – stay 4 nights and pay for only 3. The 4th night is completely free, with only the conservancy fee payable for that night (Valid for travel year round except
Jul/Aug/Sept) (Only valid for stays with 4 consecutive nights at the same Porini camp.) Not valid for Nairobi Tented Camp
Offers are not combinable with any others
Payment
A 25% deposit is required to confirm a booking and the balance due 60 days before clients arrival.
Terms:
Bookings cancelled/amended from confirmation up to 120 days before start of the safari incur a 25% cancellation charge.
Less than 120 days and up to 60 days prior to start of the safari 35% cancellation charge,
Cancellation Less than 60 days but up to 30 days prior to start of the safari 50% cancellation charge,
Policy: Less than 30 days but up to 15 days prior to start of the safari 75% cancellation charge,
Less than 15 days or more than 3 days prior to start of the safari 90% cancellation charge,
Days or less before start of the safari 100% cancellation charge.
Disclaimer: Gamewatchers Safaris Ltd. reserves the right to review these rates in the event of currency fluctuations, cost increases, tax increases or other events out of their control.
